meta.title: Computer use
meta.description: Codex-style computer use. Adds two MCP tool sets to the agent: desktop control through Cua Driver (screenshot, click, type, scroll, keys, drag, list windows) and Chromium automation through Playwright MCP (navigate, screenshot, click, type, scroll, snapshot). Desktop control requires the cua-driver executable on PATH (install with `pip install cua-driver`); browser control requires Playwright's Chromium (`npx playwright install chromium`). Tools appear as mcp__cua-driver-mcp__* and mcp__playwright__*. The agent can observe and operate the local desktop and a browser, including screenshots and input; turning the plugin off withdraws both tool sets.
